### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, A01 does not appear in any of the 200 traces; in the later window it occurs exactly once in every trace (participation 0 in 100 cases before, 100 in 100 after). [OCC001, POS001]
- In the earlier window, every observed outgoing transition of A07 goes to A04, and A04 follows A07 at a distance of one step in all 200 traces; in the later window, A07's observed transitions all go to A01 instead, and A04 follows A07 at a distance of two steps in all 200 traces. [DIR002, LAG001]
- In the later window, all observed outgoing transitions of A01 go to A04; A01 had no observed outgoing transitions in the earlier window because it was not observed at all. [DIR001]
- The pair relations flip from "never together" to "always together in a fixed order": A01 and A04 co-occur in every later trace with A01 first, and A01 and A07 co-occur in every later trace with A07 first, whereas before, A04 and A07 each occurred without A01 in all traces containing either activity. [REL001, REL002]
- Relative positions shift consistently with one step inserted between A07 and A04: A07's mean relative position moves from 0.40 to about 0.33, A04's from 0.60 to about 0.67, and A01 sits at 0.50 in every later trace; positions show no spread in either window. [POS003, POS002, POS001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that, in the later window, a step A01 is executed between A07 and A04 in every case: where A07 previously led directly to A04, it now leads to A01, which in turn leads to A04, with A01 running exactly once per case while A07 and A04 keep their relative order. This is shown directly by the redirection of A07's successor, the fixed A07-before-A01 and A01-before-A04 orders, the A07-to-A04 distance growing from one to two steps, and A01 appearing in 100 in 100 later traces; the nine qualifying control-flow items (from 9 units tested) far exceed the roughly 0.04 expected by chance in an unchanged process, and each difference is larger than in about 995 of 1,000 random re-splits. [DIR002, DIR001, REL002, REL001, LAG001, OCC001, POS001, POS002, POS003]

Limitations: A01 was not observed at all in the earlier window, so the evidence cannot distinguish a newly added step from one that already existed but was not executed in the 200 before-traces — zero participation only means "not observed"; the items also all describe this single underlying difference, so they are not independent confirmations. [OCC001, POS001]

Other differences: none observed; the small position shifts of A07 (0.40 to 0.33) and A04 (0.60 to 0.67) are consequences of the same insertion rather than separate changes. [POS003, POS002]
